name: Homeowner Assistance Program
note: Current URA page says the application round is closed. Keep for reopening and recurrence monitoring.

name: OwnPGH Homeownership Program
note: Historical high-value Pittsburgh program. Do not count toward a current stack unless URA reopens or replaces it.

name: Keystone Flex Purchase & Improvement with K-FIT
fundingForm: Mortgage repair funds plus forgivable assistance
note: Up to $30,000 of eligible repairs; transaction-specific PHFA and K-FIT requirements still apply.

name: Keystone Forgivable in Ten Years (K-FIT)
note: Assistance is based on the qualifying transaction rather than a single flat maximum.

name: Home Accessibility Program for Independence (HAPI)
note: The 2026 application round ended July 31, 2026. Monitor for another round.

name: Down Payment and Closing Cost Assistance Program
note: Up to $7,500 for qualifying first-time buyers below 80% AMI and up to $5,000 for qualifying buyers between 80% and 115% AMI.

name: Strengthen Mississippi Homes
note: Current 2026 interest forms are limited to qualifying MWUA Wind Pool policyholders in Hancock, Harrison and Jackson counties. Owner-occupied single-family primary residences only; mobile homes and rentals do not qualify.

name: Section 504 Home Repair Loans & Grants - Mississippi
note: Standard maximum grant is $10,000 for qualifying applicants; repair loans can reach $40,000 and may be combined with grants. Exact household and rural-address eligibility must be verified.

name: Section 504 Home Repair Loans & Grants - Pennsylvania
note: Useful for rural Western Pennsylvania rather than Pittsburgh proper. Exact address and applicant eligibility must be verified before counting it in a stack.
